environment.configuration: 2D Release, normal -O2 engine/game targets, KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING OFF, PCH ON, compiler cache OFF, LTO OFF, mold
environment.workers_and_affinity: Four workers on CPUs 0,2,4,6 (one thread per performance core)
environment.host_activity: Heavy unrelated CPU activity, observed load above 50 during baseline GCC compilation. Host activity varied substantially across phases. Load averages are retained for completed timing samples.

implementation.lightweight_values: Move Flip enum/operators/mirroring helpers unchanged from backend.hpp to flip.hpp. Backend still includes flip.hpp, retaining existing helper visibility.
implementation.explicit_dependencies: Render commands include ClipRegion/Flip, ECS rendering includes draw_trace, and normal lighting includes DataBuffer/Flip and forward-declares RendererBackendCapabilities.
implementation.consumer_repairs: Add Renderer2D definition includes to implementation/test sources that instantiate the renderer or call its methods. No method bodies or rendering fields changed.
implementation.compatibility: External consumers relying on renderer definitions through data headers need a direct renderer2d.hpp include when constructing/calling Renderer2D.
implementation.contracts: Nine separate header translation units; component definitions and Flecs usage requirements; C++23, PCH disabled and unity disabled.

plan_method.method: Temporarily append a comment, run Ninja -n against a copy of the generated manifest in the same configured build (avoiding the dry-run CMake glob regeneration stop), then restore original bytes and nanosecond timestamps.
plan_method.real_build_cross_check: Every completed real renderer-header edit produced exactly the object set in the corresponding plan.

timing_method.scope: Renderer2D header edit through hex_demo link. Existing engine PCHs/dependencies/shaders and unaffected objects prebuilt; includes game PCH, affected C++ objects, archives and final link.
timing_method.timer: GNU time around taskset -c 0,2,4,6 cmake --build BUILD --parallel 4 --target hex_demo
timing_method.completed_samples: One original and one changed run per compiler; individual observations, not medians or confidence estimates.
timing_method.order: Completed originals: Clang then GCC. An additional original GCC repeat was interrupted under sustained external contention. Changed runs: GCC then Clang. Versions not interleaved.
timing_method.repetition_change: Initially planned two rounds per compiler/version. After baseline load rose above 50, stopped additional repeats and retained all completed original samples. Script now runs one round to reproduce the completed sample design.
timing_method.restoration: Restore header bytes/timestamps after each edit. Rebuild each measured game PCH after timing so its input attributes match the restored header.
timing_method.interpretation: Timing observations are exploratory because sample count is one and host activity differs. No percentage wall-speedup claim. Structural object counts are the stronger result.
timing_method.memory: Maximum child-process RSS, not aggregate simultaneous compiler memory.

interrupted_repeat.reason: Stop additional timing repeats under sustained external host load above 50; retain completed baseline runs as exploratory samples.

layout_validation.scope: sizeof/alignof for eleven renderer data types and Flip numeric values; GCC/Clang with render-probe on/off. This is not a general cross-platform ABI certification.

limits: Rebuild counts apply to the recorded targets/configurations; they do not imply the same percentage change to a clean build or game-source edit.
Wall samples have heavy, varying background contention, and only one completed observation per version/compiler; do not treat their ratio as a controlled speedup.
Class fields, signatures and function bodies were preserved; external callers may need explicit renderer/type includes.
3D checks are syntax/template compilation only. No Windows/MSVC or full 3D/GPU runtime validation in this round.

steps: Create an isolated worktree at base_commit, persistent builds per compiler, and prebuild the three recorded targets with the configuration above. Adjust paths and select a TMPDIR with space.
Before applying the diff, run renderer_fanout.py before, renderer_measure.py before and renderer_layout.py before.

Apply the header cleanup and direct consumer includes; build the standalone contracts. Run renderer_syntax.py clang, repair missing includes, then rerun failed sources using KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY. Run renderer_syntax.py gcc clang-3d.
Run renderer_validate.py, using four optimized baseline Lua API reports as references, then renderer_layout.py after. The recorded probe source is embedded.
After all validation compilers finish, run renderer_fanout.py after and renderer_measure.py after. Keep agent-owned validation work out of timing; record external host load.
Run renderer_restore.py and renderer_mechanical.py. Retain all completed samples and label interrupted attempts explicitly.

import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,shlex,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time');base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-renderer-header-bench';env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(base/'kin-renderer-header-tmp')};selected=sys.argv[1:] or ['clang','gcc','clang-3d'];tasks=[]
for mode in selected:
 build=base/{'clang':'kin-build-time-clang','gcc':'kin-build-time-out','clang-3d':'kin-build-time-3d-clang'}[mode]
 for entry in json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text()):
  source=pathlib.Path(entry['file'])
  if source.suffix!='.cpp' or not source.resolve().is_relative_to(repo):continue
  only=set(filter(None,os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY','').split(',')))
  if only and str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo)) not in only:continue
  args=shlex.split(entry['command']);cmd=[];i=0
  while i<len(args):
   if args[i:i+2] in [['-Xclang','-include-pch'],['-Xclang','-include']] and i+3<len(args) and args[i+2]=='-Xclang' and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+3]:i+=4;continue
   if args[i] in ['-include','-include-pch'] and i+1<len(args) and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+1]:i+=2;continue
   if args[i]=='-o':i+=2;continue
   if args[i] in ['-c','-fpch-preprocess','-Winvalid-pch','-fpch-instantiate-templates']:i+=1;continue
   cmd.append(args[i]);i+=1
  cmd.append('-fsyntax-only');relative=str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo));tasks.append((mode,build,relative,cmd))
# Report production errors before tests to speed up dependency repairs.
tasks.sort(key=lambda t:('/tests/' in '/'+t[2],not any(x in t[2] for x in ['/renderer/','/particles/','/tilemap/','/ecs/']),t[0],t[2]))
def check(task):
 mode,build,relative,cmd=task;log=out/('syntax-'+mode+'-'+relative.replace('/','_')+'.log');started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=build,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'configuration':mode,'source':relative,'exit_code':r.returncode,'wall_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'pch':False}
 if r.returncode:print('FAIL '+mode+' '+relative+'\n'+log.read_text()[:5000],flush=True)
 return row
rows=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(check,t) for t in tasks]):
  rows.append(future.result());(out/('syntax-results-'+'-'.join(selected)+('-targeted' if os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY') else '')+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'checked':len(rows),'failures':sum(r['exit_code']!=0 for r in rows)}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(r['exit_code'] for r in rows))
